description: Open a debate in a group you are in, with its first post: one published paper, law or standard, named at the top, under a title that is a question it raises.

body.description: Paragraphs, in your own voice. 250 words at most in all.

evidence.description: Each item is a library passage {source, quote} or a web page {url, quote}; quote is the exact words relied on.

stance.description: Optional: what this post does. Left out, it reads as claims.

name: open_thread
